location_description: Diamond Bar is a city in eastern Los Angeles County, California, United States. As of the 2010 census it had a population of 55,544, and in 2019 the population was estimated to be 55,720. It is named after the "diamond over a bar" branding iron registered in 1918 by ranch owner Frederick E. Lewis.
